Exact times: Temporal's Instant

Source: R/instant.R
instant.Rd

An instant() is an exact point on the time line with nanosecond precision and no calendar or time zone, stored as a complex vector whose real part is the whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00Z and whose imaginary part is the nanoseconds within that second. The range is 10^8 days either side of the epoch. The constructor is Temporal.Instant and Temporal.Instant.from() in one.

Usage

instant(x)

instant_from_epoch_milliseconds(x)

instant_from_epoch_nanoseconds(x)

instant_compare(x, y)

Arguments

x

A string in ISO 8601 form with Z or a UTC offset ("2026-01-31T12:30:45.123456789Z", "2026-01-31T12:30+05:30"), an instant() to return as is, or a zoned_date_time() or POSIXct or POSIXlt value to take the exact time of. For instant_from_epoch_milliseconds(), integral milliseconds since the epoch; for instant_from_epoch_nanoseconds(), integral nanoseconds as numbers exact in a double or as decimal strings.

y

An instant() or a string, for instant_compare().

Value

An instant() vector; instant_compare() returns an integer vector of -1, 0 and 1.

Members

Every member of Temporal.Instant in the pinned specification (inst/spec/PINS) and the R function that implements it:

TemporalR
new Temporal.Instant()instant()
Temporal.Instant.from()instant()
Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds()instant_from_epoch_milliseconds()
Temporal.Instant.fromEpochNanoseconds()instant_from_epoch_nanoseconds()
Temporal.Instant.compare()instant_compare()
.epochMillisecondsepoch_milliseconds()
.epochNanosecondsepoch_nanoseconds()
.add()temporal_add()
.subtract()temporal_subtract()
.until()temporal_until()
.since()temporal_since()
.round()temporal_round()
.equals()temporal_equals()
.toString()temporal_to_string()
.toLocaleString()none: ECMA-402 (locale formatting) is out of scope
.toJSON()none: format() covers it
.valueOf()none: throws in JavaScript; no R counterpart
.toZonedDateTimeISO()temporal_to_zoned_date_time_iso()

Examples

instant("2026-01-31T12:30:45.123456789Z")
#> <zutempo_instant[1]>
#> [1] 2026-01-31T12:30:45.123456789Z
instant("2026-01-31T12:30+05:30")
#> <zutempo_instant[1]>
#> [1] 2026-01-31T07:00:00Z
instant_from_epoch_milliseconds(0)
#> <zutempo_instant[1]>
#> [1] 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z
instant_from_epoch_nanoseconds("8640000000000000000000")
#> <zutempo_instant[1]>
#> [1] +275760-09-13T00:00:00Z
epoch_nanoseconds(instant("+275760-09-13T00:00Z"))
#> [1] "8640000000000000000000"
instant_compare("1969-12-31T23:59:59Z", "1970-01-01T00:00Z")
#> [1] -1
